name: Oscar S. Gifford
bio: Oscar S. Gifford was Dakota's delegate to Congress, and the paper followed his bid for renomination at the Republican convention in Yankton in September 1886. He was re-elected that November, and in December he offered a bill for a railroad bridge across the Missouri near Yankton.
